newsitem.title: JAPAN: Isuzu forms Philippine truck parts unit.
newsitem.headline: Isuzu forms Philippine truck parts unit.

text.p: Isuzu Motors Ltd said on Tuesday it had set up a wholly owned unit in Laguna, the Philippines, to produce manual gearboxes for pickup trucks.
The new company, named Isuzu Autoparts Manufacturing Corp (IAMC), is capitalised at about 100 million yen and will start production in the middle of 1998 with an annual output rate of 60,000 units.
Isuzu will invest a total of four billion yen in IAMC, an Isuzu spokesman said.
The gearboxes will be supplied to Isuzu's pickup truck production plants in Thailand and the Philippines.
The new company will have created 200 jobs by mid-1998.
